upload.supportedFormatsSuffix: and other common document formats. Files are ingested in order, ideal for curating one knowledge base's document queue.
upload.guideFirst: 1. Curate the document list here; drag to append more anytime.
upload.guideSecond: 2. Each file uses its filename as the document name by default, editable in the list.
upload.guideThird: 3. The next step picks the knowledge base, chunk size and vectorization strategy.
upload.queueDescription: {count} files in total; each document name is editable.
upload.autoVectorizeOn: Submit background indexing tasks right after upload
upload.docEnabledOn: Newly uploaded docs are enabled by default
upload.chunkSizeHint: Chunk size controls the text length of each chunk; larger values give fuller recall context.
upload.overlapSizeHint: Overlap keeps context continuous, typically 10%-20% of the chunk size.
upload.parserHint: Parser mode decides body extraction: the built-in parser works out of the box; Docling requires a separately deployed
upload.parserHintSuffix: and restores complex PDF layouts and tables better.
upload.configPersistHint: These parameters are written into each document's ingestionConfig and reused on the preview page.
upload.openPreviewHint: Automatically open the first document's chunk preview after upload
upload.stayHint: If any upload failed, the page stays on this step so you can fix and resubmit.
upload.asyncHint: Background vectorization still runs asynchronously; track progress in the doc list or status detail.
